description: A fully server-side Minecraft Fabric mod that allows the player to be downed instead of dying. Other players can revive a downed player.

mods.name: Down But Not Out
mods.description: Revive downed players: instead of dying, players drop to half a heart and crawl. Inspired by Call of Duty Zombies. Fully server-side and compatible with vanilla and Geyser Bedrock clients.
